title: Beginner C and G Chords
description: Practice simple major triad shapes in root position.
overview: Root-position major triads use the 1st, 3rd, and 5th notes above the chord name.
goal: Learn the feel of common C, G, and F major chord shapes.
instructions: Press all highlighted chord notes together.
Hold the shape long enough to hear the chord, then release.
Notice that each major chord has the same bright quality.

fingering.note: Use thumb, middle finger, and pinky for a comfortable beginner triad shape.
Move the same thumb-middle-pinky shape so your thumb starts on G.
Move the same thumb-middle-pinky shape so your thumb starts on F.
